name: Kwaku Kusi Appiah
bio: Kwaku is a mechanical engineering student who enjoys coding and building things. He is drawn to new technology and to projects where software and hardware meet, and he started the society to give Oberlin students a place to build together.

name: Mahi Zarif
bio: Mahi is a third-year student studying electrical engineering. He works alongside Kwaku on recruiting the founding team, choosing the society's first projects, and getting its first events running.

name: Mina Stalhamer
bio: Mina manages the society's budget, funding requests, purchases, and reimbursements, and keeps the financial records the group will hand to next year's team.

name: Open position
bio: Helps teams define scope, identify tools and mentors, schedule check-ins, and publish honest project updates.

bio: Plans welcoming meetings, gathers scheduling and access needs, and coordinates speakers or campus collaborators after details are confirmed.
